patch_list: Removes Lock and Add to playlist from the video and folder 3-dot bottom sheets and from the selection toolbar menus. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Disables the rate dialog counters so it never appears.

Shows resolution, date, size and last played on video rows, and video count, size and path on folder rows. Fixes the gap above Recent Added and adds a Mod Settings option to hide the Recent Added and Directory rows. Toggles in Mod Settings.
Hides the bottom tab bar on the home screen. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Hides the cast button in the toolbar menus. Toggle it in Mod Settings.
Hide Cast FF FB In Player
Hides the cast, custom and 10 second forward/backward buttons in the player. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Hides the tile row at the top of the home page (All Videos, Downloader, Privacy, Cleaner...) and the Move to Trash option in the delete dialog. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Hides the recent videos row on the home page. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Removes Widgets from the home 3-dot menu.
Adds a Mod Settings entry below Settings in the home 3-dot menu.
Cleans the player side menu: audio, subtitle, cast, bookmark, favorite, play mode, brightness and volume. Applied while the menu inflates so remaining items stay aligned. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Skips the Visual Enhancer enable animation and applies effects instantly without reloading the video. Toggle in Mod Settings.
Launches directly into the file explorer instead of the splash screen.
Raises the volume boost limit in the player and background playback. Toggle in Mod Settings.
